lines.1: There was no one on the roof.
lines.2: 「I guess not many people come up to the roof on opening-ceremony day.」
lines.3: 「We can't exactly flirt in the hallway.」
lines.4: 「That's what makes a place like this perfect for the two of us to talk.」
lines.5: 「Did you tell your class? About us dating?」
lines.6: 「I mean, word got around all by itself.」
lines.7: 「Yeah, that sort of thing probably spreads fast in Class 2-C.」
lines.10: 「Actually, they figured it out. They said my makeup had started looking more grown-up and stuff.」
lines.13: 「I get so carried away whenever I talk about you.」
lines.15: 「--And he's honestly so hopeless, such a total mess, that I just have to look after him, don't I?」
lines.16: 「And get this: he says the most embarrassing things with a straight face. It's such a pain. Want an example? Well...」
lines.18: 「By the time I noticed, everyone around me was giving me these really annoyed looks.」
lines.19: 「They'd had their fill of your love life, huh?」
lines.20: 「Yeah. I let my guard down--me, of all people.」
lines.21: 「So make sure you don't do the same.」
lines.55: 「I'm not about to underestimate my opponent, so I'm working pretty hard on it.」
lines.57: 「It's only polite to give your opponent everything you've got.」
lines.58: Well, I guess that's true, but...
lines.59: Konoe was pouring everything into it.
lines.60: The Princess, meanwhile, was having fun with hers...
lines.61: Something about that difference bothered me.
